method: Use full class::JUnit testcase name identity (including dataset suffixes). Start with completed whole-billing green run; overwrite overlapping identities from later completed passing selections in the explicit order. Keep driver skips as skips, never as passes. Earlier completed green selections contain no additional identities. Runtime-only external probes are excluded. Assertions sum each identity once using its latest applicable completed passing selection.
note: Source identities vary by selection; this is historical unique coverage, not a single final-head execution. The three deadline case results now use the frozen-clock correction (3/38); the other fifteen cases retain the prior 18/176 selection source. Older results remain in source-map and original receipts.
